name: @oxyos/shell
description: OxyOS's shell (docs/adr/0009-session-shell.mdx). Its build takes Bloom from BLOOM_DIR, which must be a version this accepts: the top bar is Bloom's Menubar, its menus desktop menus in the platform's popups with submenus beside their rows, driven from the keyboard by its focusValue (15.77.0).
